newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche shares stay weak in bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche shares stay weak in bourse trade.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Bank AG remained weak in bourse trade on Wednesday in the aftermath of problems at the group's Morgan Grenfell Asset Management unit in the U.K.
Shares in Deutsche were down 25 pfennigs or 0.35 percent at 71.25 marks in bourse trade at 0944 GMT, while the DAX index was down 5.09 points or 0.20 percent at 2,565.86 points.
Deutsche shares fell as low as 71.16 marks in pre-bourse electronic trade earlier.

Deutsche has been under pressure since its funds unit, Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM) temporarily suspended three of its funds and an urgent investigation into possible "irregularities" was launched in conjunction with regulators.
Deutsche Bank bought all the contentious shares in the three funds for around 420 million marks to protect the 90,000 investors involved from losses.
